label: RANK_STALLED_BEFORE_COLLECTIVE
fix_claim: Rank 1 was mapped to a nonexistent shard directory (part-4) in config.yaml, so it blocked in open_shard waiting for shard 1 before entering the step-7 collective; I changed shard_dirs for rank 1 to part-1 so its shard resolves like the other ranks.
patch:
--- a/job/config.yaml
+++ b/job/config.yaml
@@ -20,5 +20,5 @@
   shard_dirs:
     0: part-0
-    1: part-4
+    1: part-1
     2: part-2
     3: part-3
